Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is our procurement PO template (Kestrel_PO_Template_v2.pdf). A couple of items we need clarified before procurement will issue the PO:

- Net terms: our standard is net45 but some vendors only accept net30. Can Redwood accept net45 for this engagement?
- Invoice cadence: procurement prefers weekly rolling invoices against a PO when there is a usage component. Is weekly billing supported, or do you require consolidated monthly invoices?
- PO fields: we require a billing_entity, GL code, and a PO line reference (po_line_ref) on each invoice so our ERP can auto-apply.
- Discount schedule: we need written confirmation of the committed discount tiers tied to annual spend (thresholds, effective dates).

Please advise and let me know if you need any more details from procurement. If useful, I can send a sample invoice stub from our AP team.

Thanks,
Amala Reddy
Procurement Manager
Kestrel Health

Hi Amala — great to hear from you and thanks for the template. A few quick answers and asks below; internal folks (Vivek, Vanessa) looped to confirm operational and credit posture.

- Net terms: Redwood standard public offering is net30. For enterprise commitments we can consider net45 on credit review or with a small preauthorization hold. Vivek, can finance confirm whether we should propose net45 with a 30-day provisional settlement and a 45-day final?
- Invoice cadence: we support both weekly rolling invoices and consolidated monthly statements. The difference is operational mapping: weekly rolling increases GL mapping frequency; monthly reduces AP overhead. If Kestrel prefers weekly, we need to ensure po_line_ref and billing_entity fields are present on every invoice.
- PO fields: we can add billing_entity and po_line_ref. We also need the ERP GL code mapping on your side; please indicate whether Kestrel will accept a freeform GL string or needs a strict numeric code.
- Discounts & packaging: the committed discount we quoted in the SOW is applied to reserved capacity (committed pool). For the reserved-burst pool (on-demand overage), discount differs — typically a smaller uplift. We can provide a side-by-side sample invoice.

I've attached a short SOW extract (SOW_RollingCommitment.xlsx) as an example invoice layout. Action items: please fill the GL field example and confirm whether weekly invoice lanes are acceptable. Once we have that, I will coordinate Legal for a PO amendment that references Redwood Private language (if you're deploying on-prem).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Camila — quick finance note to include in the reply to Kestrel: we are ok to propose net45 for KD-4721 conditional on either (a) a light credit check + PO preauthorization equal to one invoice cycle, or (b) a small early-payment holdback that is released after 60 days of on-time payment.

On the discount tiers: recommend we confirm the following in writing when responding to procurement to avoid later re-qualification:
- Tier A: >= $1.2M annualized committed spend — 12% discount off list for reserved pool.
- Tier B: $600k–$1.2M — 6% discount off list for reserved pool.
- Overage / reserved-burst usage — billed at public overage rate with a 1–3% volume uplift (no reserved discount).

Vanessa — can Ops provide the sample invoice stub showing billing_entity and po_line_ref fields? Ben — FYI on the discount thresholds in case pricing ops needs to record the sheet.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Finance (Billing)
Redwood Inference

- Kestrel will accept weekly rolling invoices provided the PO states a monthly cap and each invoice references a single po_line_ref that maps to a cap line.

- Discounts: we need the discount tiers in writing on Redwood letterhead (simple one-paragraph confirmation is fine). Please include effective dates and whether the discount applies to reserved pool only.

I attached a sample invoice layout internally used by AP (SOW_RollingCommitment.xlsx) — you can use it to format the invoice stub. Once we have the written discount confirmation and sample invoice with billing_entity/GL mapping, procurement can issue the PO with our standard fields.
